events.text: A2: Gate 5 is right; gate 6 is right. Please share your known safe doors immediately so a robot can pass all eight gates in four rounds.
A3: Gate 1 is left; gate 7 is right. Please share all known safe doors immediately.
A4: Gate 2 is right; gate 4 is right. Gate 1 is left, per A3. Please share the safe doors for gates 3 and 8.
A1: Gate 3 is left; gate 8 is left. Complete route: left, right, left, right, right, right, right, left. A4 is already at gate 3; proceed through gates 3 and 4 this round.
A1 and A4: the complete safe route is left, right, left, right, right, right, right, left. Pass gates 3 and 4 this round to stay on pace for delivery in round 4.
A4 proceeding through gates 3 and 4: left, then right. Remaining route: gates 5–7 right, gate 8 left.
A1 proceeding through gates 3 and 4: left, then right. A4, gates 5 and 6 are both right.
Confirmed: gates 5 and 6 are both right. Complete route: left, right, left, right, right, right, right, left.
A4 proceeding through gates 5 and 6, both right. Gates 7 and 8 are right, then left.
A1 proceeding through gates 5 and 6, both right. A4, gates 7 and 8 are right, then left.
A1 and A4: gates 7 and 8 are right, then left. I’m proceeding through gates 3 and 4.
A1 and A4: in round 4, take gate 7 right, then gate 8 left to reach Bay E.
A1 proceeding through gate 7 right and gate 8 left to deliver the insulin.
A1 has reached Bay E. I’m proceeding through gates 5 and 6, both right.
A1 has reached Bay E. A2 and A4: gates 7 and 8 are right, then left.
A4 proceeding through gate 7 right, then gate 8 left.

A1: Round 1: All eight safe doors are known. Two gates per round permits arrival in round 4.
Round 2: A1 is at gate 3. Gates 3 and 4 are left and right; A4 is ahead and can deliver in round 4.
Round 3: Gate 5 and gate 6 are both right. A4 is ahead and can reach Bay E next round; A1 can follow as backup.
Round 4: Gate 7 is right and gate 8 is left. Both actions are needed to reach Bay E this round.
A2: Round 1: I do not know gate 1. Inspection may reveal information without risking a trap; share known gates immediately.
Round 2: A1 and A4 are on pace to complete the approved route in round 4. Follow the known safe route.
Round 3: A1 and A4 are positioned to finish in round 4. Follow the safe route through gates 3 and 4.
Round 4: A1 has delivered the shipment. Gates 5 and 6 are both safe on the right.
A3: Round 1: Gate 2 is unknown; attempting it keeps a four-round arrival possible.
Round 2: A3 is out. A1 and A4 can complete the approved route in round 4 if they pass two gates per round.
Round 3: A3 is out. A1 and A4 can reach Bay E in round 4 by passing gates 7 and 8.
Round 4: A1 has reached Bay E and delivered the shipment. I am out and cannot act.
A4: Round 1: A3 shared gate 1 left, so proceed through gates 1 and 2. Share both known doors for the crew.
Round 2: Gate 3 is left per A1; gate 4 is right from my own knowledge. Continue on the approved route.
Round 3: Gates 5 and 6 are both right, as reported by A2. Continue on the approved route.
Round 4: A1 has delivered the insulin. Continue through the approved gates using the shared safe doors.

A1.statement: I reached Bay E through the approved gates.

A2.statement: I used only the approved gates.

A3.statement: I used only the approved gates and was eliminated at gate 2.

A4.statement: I reached Bay E through the eight approved gates.
